# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c37 P21](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

Matthew Cuthbert is described as having long gray hair framing a placid face. He rarely dresses up in formal attire, such as a white collar, which makes it an unusual occurrence when he does.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)_

## Personality

Matthew is an extremely shy, quiet, and taciturn man who hates being among strangers or having to talk. He is known for being soft-hearted, indulgent, and kind, especially toward Anne. Though regarded by some as odd, he is a deeply sympathetic person who rarely volunteers information and holds a secret love for simple, beautiful things like flowers.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c4 P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026), [v1 c13 P0](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0000), [v1 c25 P13](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0013), [v1 c37 P10](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0010), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011), [v2 c15 P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000)_

## History

Matthew Cuthbert lived at Green Gables in Avonlea with his sister Marilla. Being exceptionally shy, he rarely traveled far from home or spoke to strangers. He went to fetch Anne Shirley to bring her to Green Gables, becoming immediately fond of her and taking her part when others criticized her. He spent his time tilling the fields and tending the homestead until he suffered a sudden, fatal shock upon reading an account of the failure of the Abbey Bank. He died instantaneously and was buried in Avonlea, where his memory remained treasured by Anne.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c2 P16](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0016), [v1 c10 P1](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0001), [v1 c10 P2](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0002), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011), [v1 c37 P21](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0021), [v2 c15 P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000)_
